payload.before: The prompt hook adds to each owner prompt a short list of the most relevant records, one line each and only when new to the session or changed (SR-032; their tests come from plumb show), and, using the configured language-model judge, flags a prompt that contradicts or extends a confirmed requirement as a possible intent change. When no judge is configured or the judge cannot be reached, the hook says so in one line once per session, naming the setting or the cause; it flags nothing by fixed rules, saves no flag, and still lists the records.
payload.reason: you decided INT-029: "Understand intent and text with language models, not fixed rules"
payload.topic: Flagging prompts that may change a confirmed requirement
